title: Break the Checkbox: Challenging Closed-Style Evaluations of Cultural Alignment in LLMs
reasoning: The paper uses dimensions from the World Values Survey (WVS) and Hofstede's framework to evaluate model alignment, specifically including tests for 'Religious Values' (e.g., the importance of God) and 'Ethical Values and Norms' (e.g., the justifiability of abortion and homosexuality).
